findings.paved_road: At each of those points also assert `d.journal.events == []`, or that no `signal` event has body `signal == "panel_facts"`.

findings.message: The Recording fake now journals panel_facts, but the negative checks for the single-member and non-ok paths still look only at the engine log: `assert driver.log.events == []` (line 109), `not driver.log.events` (lines 209, 219) and `all(name != "panel_facts" for name, _ in driver.log.events)` (line 279). Since the signal never reaches the log, these checks cannot fail, so nothing tests the Definition-of-rejected rule that a size-1 stage or a failed panel writes no signal.
findings.paved_road: In those assertions, also assert that the driver's journal holds no `signal` event with `signal == "panel_facts"`.
